# Cannot compute: CN code is missing

I cannot calculate the embedded emissions figure because one required input is missing.

## Input check

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code in the table | "Steel goods" (no CN code) | **Missing** |
| (b) Country of production | India | ✅ Listed in the table |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | 3,000 t | ✅ Provided |

## Missing input

**The CN code of the good.** The ruleset selects the default SEE by both CN code and country. "Steel goods" could match several India entries with different factors:

| CN code | Good | India default SEE (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|---|
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, of iron and non-alloy steel | 2.64 |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel | 4.32 |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods, of iron or non-alloy steel | 4.27 |

7201 (pig iron and spiegeleisen) is also in the table, but pig iron is not usually called a steel good. Because the factors differ, I cannot pick one or estimate.

## Next step

Please provide the CN code for the 3,000 t produced in India. I will then calculate:

**Embedded emissions = India default SEE for that CN code × 3,000 t**, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.

If the 3,000 t covers more than one good, please give the CN code and tonnage for each.
